page_title: VEN 0-2 ATA | Venezia v Atalanta 20/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' That's the end of the match.
90+2' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Gianluca Busio (Venezia) was quite harsh and Luca Zufferli didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90' 3 additional min. will be played.
90' Gianluca Busio (Venezia) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.

88' Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
87' Luca Zufferli blows for a foul after Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Atalanta are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.

85' Gianluca Busio (Venezia) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots low towards the middle of the goal. Marco Carnesecchi is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
82' Shots on target – 2:7.
81' A player from Venezia commits a rough challenge. Luca Zufferli blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Atalanta are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
79' Here is a change. Joel Pohjanpalo is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Christian Gytkjaer (Venezia).
79' The substitution has been made. Saad El Haddad (Venezia) has replaced Gaetano Oristanio.
78' Alfred Duncan (Venezia) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Luca Zufferli blows for a foul. Atalanta have a free kick.
77' Corner kick. Venezia will have an opportunity.

77' Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players. The referee blows his whistle, Venezia are awarded a corner kick.
75' Substitution. Ederson did his best and is replaced by Ibrahim Sulemana (Atalanta).

75' Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Venezia will have a goal kick.
74' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the bottom left corner, but Filip Stankovic is equal to it and makes an easy save.
73' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Atalanta.
72' Atalanta have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

72' Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the roof of the net. Filip Stankovic is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. Atalanta force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
70' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
68' Gian Piero Gasperini prepares a substitution. Mateo Retegui is replaced by Nicolo Zaniolo (Atalanta).
68' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Charles De Ketelaere as he is replaced by Lazar Samardzic (Atalanta).

68' What a chance that is! Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a pass on the edge of the box. His attempt goes just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
67' Venezia enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
66' Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
65' Atalanta control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
64' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Ridgeciano Haps (Venezia) replacing Richie Sagrado.
64' It will be a substitution. John Yeboah (Venezia) is ready to enter the pitch as Hans Nicolussi Caviglia walks off.
63' Neat passing move from Atalanta in order to create new attacking opportunities.

61' Antonio Candela (Venezia) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
58' Atalanta are ruled offside.
56' Gianluca Busio (Venezia) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. There is a free kick near the sideline to Atalanta.
56' Juan Cuadrado (Atalanta) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
55' Richie Sagrado (Venezia) makes a strong challenge and Luca Zufferli blows for a foul. It's a free kick to Atalanta, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.

54' Ederson (Atalanta) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he produced a shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the bottom left corner, but Filip Stankovic made an astonishing save!
47' 0 - 2 Goal! Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) picks up a pass and gets to the edge of the box before clipping a brilliant lob over the goalkeeper and into the empty net. He makes it 0:2.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Eusebio Di Francesco gives a chance to Gianluca Busio and Mikael Egill Ellertsson (Venezia) is off.
46' Half-time substitution. Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) will not participate anymore and Juan Cuadrado is coming on.
46' Half-time substitution. Gian Piero Gasperini decided to make a change. Isak Hien (Atalanta) is replaced by Matteo Ruggeri.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Venezia was in an offside position.
45+1' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) takes the free kick from mid-range, but he balloons his effort high over the bar. What a miskick! The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
43' Ederson (Atalanta) has tested the patience of referee Luca Zufferli and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
43' Ederson (Atalanta) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent. Venezia earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.

43' Alfred Duncan (Venezia) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
42' Ederson (Atalanta) commits a rough foul. Luca Zufferli stops the game and makes a call. Venezia are awarded the free kick.

41' A short pass finds Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
40' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Atalanta is cautioned for aggressive play. It's a free kick to Venezia in a dangerous position.
37' Richie Sagrado (Venezia) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.

35' Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the roof of the net is denied by a decent save from Marco Carnesecchi.
33' Fine attempt! Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) collects a pass and manages to hold off the defender, then rifles in a shot from mid-range which unluckily swerves inches past the left post.
33' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) takes a short free kick.

32' It seems like Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) is about to take a free kick. The goalkeeper has to be alert and careful how to position the defensive wall. This is the perfect distance for a direct shot.
31' Alfred Duncan (Venezia) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Luca Zufferli saw the whole situation. Atalanta have a free kick from a promising distance.
29' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) expertly controls a neat clever pass on the edge of the penalty area, but his effort smashes against the crossbar! What an opportunity!
28' Great teamplay by Atalanta as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
27' A clumsy foul by Jay Idzes (Venezia) and Luca Zufferli blows his whistle. Atalanta win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
26' It's a throw-in for Venezia.
23' Francesco Zampano (Venezia) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.

22' The corner is aimed towards the penalty spot where it's met by Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia), but his timing is poor and it flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
22' Alfred Duncan (Venezia) is about to take a corner kick.

21' That was a nice football moment. Francesco Zampano (Venezia) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the right post. Marco Carnesecchi guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save! The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Venezia.
19' Atalanta seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
18' A corner kick by Atalanta is thwarted by the well prepared Filip Stankovic (Venezia).

17' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atalanta.
13' An accurate cross picks out Mateo Retegui (Atalanta) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Venezia.
13' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

12' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top left corner, but Filip Stankovic makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! The linesman points to the corner flag, Atalanta are going to take it.
7' 0 - 1 Gooal! Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) scores with a shot from inside the box after latching onto a headed pass from Mateo Retegui. He makes it 0:1.
7' The ball is out of play and Atalanta manage to earn a corner.

6' Atalanta players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass. The linesman signals a throw-in for Venezia.

4' What a big chance! Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and misses the net well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Atalanta will have a goal kick.
2' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

2' Atalanta are just stroking the ball across the park now, but the defence is doing very well breaking up their possession. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Atalanta.
2' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Venezia will have the kick-off.
Luca Zufferli is the one to supervise the game today.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
